app.name: JAYL STUDIO
app.tagline: Get your assets ready. On your own machine, with nothing sent anywhere.

cutout.label: Remove background
cutout.help: Takes the background away and keeps only the subject, on transparency.

vector.label: Vectorise
vector.help: Turns pixels into shapes you can scale as large as you like without going blurry.

editor.label: SVG editor
editor.help: Opens and edits vector files: move things, recolour them, add text and shapes.

image.label: Image
image.help: Generate an image from a description, using your work as reference.

video.label: Video
video.help: Generate a video from a description and your references.

sound.label: Sound
sound.help: Build a sound effect by imitating it with your voice and describing it.

drop.title: Drop an image here
drop.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP, large print files included. Nothing leaves this computer.
drop.vectorHint: Works better with flat colours, logos and line art than with photographs.

quality.label: Quality
quality.help: Higher means cleaner edges but a few more seconds of waiting.

language.label: Language
language.help: Changes the language of the whole interface, straight away.

background.label: Background
background.help: The colour behind your artwork in the exported file. Transparent leaves it empty.

format.label: Format
format.help: The size of the finished file. Pick the one for wherever you will use it.

download.label: Download
download.help: Saves the finished file to your downloads folder.

reset.label: Start over
reset.help: Clears the workspace and takes you back to the first screen.

help.label: Explain
help.help: Turns explanations on: every control tells you what it does, until you turn it off.

download.title: Getting the tool ready
download.body: Downloading the cutout engine. This happens once — next time it starts immediately.

slow.title: Your browser is running in slow mode
slow.body: It has no graphics acceleration, so every cutout takes a few seconds longer and is less precise on thin edges. An up-to-date Chrome or Edge would be about three times faster.

error.title: I couldn't cut out this image
error.body: Try again, or try a different image. If it keeps happening, the file may be damaged.

result.compare: Drag the line to compare before and after
result.tooSmall: This artwork is smaller than the print area. I centred it rather than blowing it up: enlarged, it would look grainy on fabric.

library.title: Your work
library.empty: Nothing yet. Everything you make lands here.

downloadAll.label: Download all
downloadAll.help: Puts all of your work into a single zip file to save.

delete.label: Delete
delete.help: Removes this piece of work. This cannot be undone.

open.label: Open
open.help: Reopens this vector file in the editor so you can change it.

folder.help: Click to filter. Double-click deletes the folder: your work stays, it just moves out of folders.

moodboard.help: Click to see only this moodboard's work. Double-click deletes it; the work stays.

library.localWarning: Everything is saved in this browser, on your computer. Clearing the site's data wipes the archive: download everything now and then.
library.unsupported: This browser cannot keep files locally. You can still create and download work, but it won't stay in the archive.

onboarding.title: Three things and you're working
onboarding.step1: Drop an image in the big frame, or click it to pick one from your computer.
onboarding.step2: Press “Print-ready”, top right: it removes the background and brings the file to the right size, in one go. The work happens here, on your computer: no file is sent anywhere.
onboarding.step3: If the automatic pass got something wrong, use the Eraser to fix it by hand. Then pick a format and press Export.
onboarding.hint: If a control isn't clear, switch on “Explain” at the top right.

kind.label: Trace style
kind.help: How to read the image: flat colours, gradients, or black and white only.

clean.label: Tidy the result
clean.help: Makes the file lighter: fewer decimals in the paths and fewer stray specks, with the same look.

redo.label: Redo
redo.help: Reapplies the change you just undid.

group.label: Group
group.help: Joins the chosen items so they move together.

ungroup.label: Ungroup
ungroup.help: Breaks a group back into its items.

front.label: Bring forward
front.help: Puts the selection in front of everything else.

back.label: Send back
back.help: Puts the selection behind everything else.

remove.label: Delete selection
remove.help: Removes the selected items. Undo brings them straight back.

save.label: Save to your work
save.help: Adds this drawing to your work, at the bottom of the page.

clean.label: Tidy the SVG
clean.help: Rewrites the file more compactly without changing how it looks.

editor.failed: The vector editor didn't start. Reload the page; if it keeps happening, your browser may be too old.

export.label: Export and download
export.help: Builds the file in the chosen format and saves it right away.

empty.title: I found no shapes to trace
empty.body: The subject has too little contrast with the background. Try «Flat colours», or remove the background first.

select.label: Select
select.help: Pick and move elements. This is the tool you start from.

nodes.label: Nodes
nodes.help: Edit a path's points and their handles to reshape it.

pen.label: Pen
pen.help: Draw paths point by point: click for a corner, drag for a curve.

pencil.label: Pencil
pencil.help: Draw freehand; the path follows your mouse movement.

line.label: Line
line.help: Draw a straight segment between two points.

rect.label: Rectangle
rect.help: Draw a rectangle by dragging from one corner to the other.

ellipse.label: Ellipse
ellipse.help: Draw a circle or an ellipse by dragging.

text.label: Text
text.help: Click on the canvas and type. The text stays editable.

nodes.title: Nodes and handles
nodes.help: Select a path and turn node editing on: you can move the points and bend the curves by pulling the handles.
nodes.needPath: To edit nodes, select a path first: draw one with the Pen or Pencil, or click a shape you already drew.

transform.title: Position and size
transform.help: Exact values instead of dragging by eye. The arrows nudge one pixel at a time.

align.title: Align
align.help: Needs at least two elements selected. It aligns them to each other, not to the canvas.

appearance.help: Thickness is in pixels. Opacity runs from 0 (invisible) to 1 (solid).

soon.title: This service isn't here yet
soon.body: Generation is being built. When it lands you'll pay only for what you generate, and the price will be written before you press.

actions.title: What you can do with it
actions.referenceHelp: Adds it to the references for your next generation, so the subject stays the same.

brush.title: Fix by hand
brush.help: The automatic pass always gets something wrong. Here you bring back what vanished and remove what stayed.
brush.eraseHelp: Erases background that stayed stuck to the subject.
brush.restoreHelp: Restores parts of the subject the automatic pass removed by mistake.
brush.limited: Limited recovery: the starting file has different dimensions, so the colour in the already-erased areas is gone. Reopen the original file to get it back.

upscale.title: Enlarge
upscale.help: Rebuilds detail instead of just scaling up. On a print file it fills the area at the density the printer asks for: four times a 1000-pixel file gives 4000, which is 29 cm at 350 dpi.

tooBig.lato: Too wide: enlarging goes up to {side} pixels per side, because four times that is the most a browser canvas can hold.
tooBig.area: Too many pixels: enlarging goes up to about {mp} megapixels, because four times that won't fit in the tab's memory.

upscale.stopped: Enlarging stopped. The starting file is untouched.

batch.title: In bulk
batch.help: Applies the same operations to every file at once. It's what makes the tools useful when there are forty files and not one.
batch.fixHelp: Across forty files the model gets a few wrong. Click a bad one and the brush opens, with the starting file alongside so colours can be recovered.
batch.upscaleNote: enlarges as needed, file by file

sound.heard: I heard {n} hits, about {bpm} a minute.
sound.micDenied: I can't reach the microphone. You need to allow it in the browser: the prompt usually appears near the address bar.

finish.title: Before printing
finish.help: Three checks on the finished file: crop it around the subject, see what printing will actually do, and look at it on a garment before ordering.
finish.needsRaster: Open a pixel file: these measurements are read off pixels.

crop.title: Crop
crop.help: Crops around the subject, not around the middle of the canvas. That is why it doesn't cut heads off.
crop.cut: The subject doesn't fit this shape: something will be cut off.
crop.nothing: The subject already fills the image: there is nothing to remove.
crop.none: There is no subject: remove the background first.

print.title: Print check
print.help: A file can be perfect on screen and wrong on the shirt. These are measurements, not opinions: where there is no measurement there is no warning.
print.onlyPrint: This applies to print formats: pick one above.

size.ok: It will print {w}×{h} cm, inside a {area} cm area.
size.attenzione: It will print {w}×{h} cm and won't fill the {area} cm area. We don't enlarge it: on fabric it would look soft.
size.errore: It will print just {w}×{h} cm. That disappears on a chest: you need a bigger file.

background.ok: The background is transparent: only the artwork gets printed.
background.attenzione: Not a single transparent pixel: a full rectangle of ink will be printed, edges included.

edges.attenzione: {pct}% of the artwork has half-transparent edges. Direct-to-garment printing can't do half ink: it fakes it with dots, and it shows as a halo.

contrast.ok: Contrast {ratio}:1 on a {garment} garment: reads well.
contrast.attenzione: Contrast {ratio}:1 on a {garment} garment: barely reads.
contrast.errore: Contrast {ratio}:1 on a {garment} garment: practically invisible.

clipped.ok: The artwork sits fully inside the image.
clipped.attenzione: The artwork touches the image edge: almost always means it is already cut off.

empty.errore: The image is empty: there is nothing to print.

mockup.title: Mockup
mockup.help: The artwork on the garment, at the right scale. It isn't a photo and doesn't pretend to be: it answers "how big is it and where does it end".
mockup.small: On a real garment this will look like a postage stamp: enlarge it or change format.

bar.confirmClear: Remove the file from the workspace? Saved works stay in the library.

ready.short: Reached {size}: the starting file is not enough for {target} px.
ready.tooBig: Already past the enlargeable size: background removed only.

zack.label: Zack
zack.title: Your Zack button
zack.empty: Zack has nothing to do yet: turn on at least one step.

stepHelp.scontorna: The model separates the subject from the background. It is the slowest step in the chain.
stepHelp.buchi: The counters of a logo — the inside of an “o” — that cutout leaves open get filled back in. Large, deliberate holes stay open.
stepHelp.ingrandisci: Enlarges to 4000 px on the long side, the size that fills a shirt. Skipped when the file is already big enough.
stepHelp.esporta: The result lands in the library, carrying where it came from.
stepHelp.scarica: The file heads to your downloads folder as soon as it is ready.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.help: The commands the everyday job does not need. They stay open if you leave them open.
